notes.title: Phantom Trigger is 67% off & Introducing Kill It With Fire!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The summer heat is on, and we at tinyBuild wanted to do something to brighten up your day. Today, Phantom Trigger is going on a weeklong sale at 67% off.

We’ve been doing lots of interesting things recently, and I wanted to take the opportunity to highlight some of the things we’re working on.

Specifically, on August 13 (that’s next week!) we are launching Kill It With Fire - a physics comedy game about exterminating spiders and burning down your house in the process. It’s a very lighthearted game the alphas of which have had 90%+ ratings on Steam.


The game is on Pre-Order that allows you to save 10%, or you can simply Wishlist it! We greatly appreciate it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179210/Kill_It_With_Fire/

notes.title: Day 1 Patch: Fixes and controller support
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We just pushed out a small patch that addresses several issues

[list][*]Xbox One controller support issues fixed
[*]Fixed an issue when you dash over save spots they don't save, now they register by default
[*]Fixed several small glitches here and there, including some localization string issues.[/list]

We're working on rebindable controls. Heard you loud and clear. The next patch will rollout on Saturday. If you have any other additions you'd like to see, let us know!

notes.title: Phantom Trigger Open Alpha now available
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/b0tPWrh.gif[/img]

Great news everyone! We're making progress on Phantom Trigger and would like to share the Open Alpha with you. 

It contains 1 of the 5 worlds, close-to-final combat, and a teaser for the story. 

You can download it at http://PhantomTrigger.com 

Meanwhile here's a new trailer to celebrate our Switch announcement: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vGaI9GSINTk
